scope: Corollary 1.2 (Extreme left–right asymmetry) of the manuscript “An algebra of infinite little finitistic dimension” (preprints/An-algebra-of-infinite-little-finitistic-dimension-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 198 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1fb7f827f59dcca0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a finite-dimensional unital complex algebra Λ such that fin. dim Λ = Fin. dim Λ = ∞, fin. dim(Λop ) = Fin. dim(Λop ) = 0. All four dimensions here use left modules. Thus the little and big finitistic dimensions of Λ are infinite on the left and zero on the right. Injective left Λ-modules do not generate the unbounded derived category of all left Λ-modules, whereas injective right Λ-modules generate the unbounded derived category of all right Λ-modules.
